notes: Tier 1 (direct HTTP fetch) fully sufficient; no block encountered. Checked robots.txt (no Claude-specific disallow; only /episerver, /EPiServer, /App_Data, /modules, /search disallowed for all bots) and confirmed no full-site block. Fetched sitemap.xml (578 URLs): entirely product-detail pages (378 under /product/), plus /content/ (about/showroom pages), /lighting-guide/, /sofa-experience/, /ar/, /design-days/, /our-sustainable-perspectives/ etc. No category/PLP URLs are listed in the sitemap at all, so it was not usable to find a seasonal PLP by itself; grepped it case-insensitively for christmas|xmas|halloween|easter|valentine|diwali|thanksgiving|new-year|newyear|seasonal|holiday|advent|festive -> zero matches anyway. Fetched homepage HTML directly and extracted the full internal-link set (125 unique hrefs), which reproduces Muuto's complete top-level product taxonomy: /products/accessories/ (candleholders, cushions, hangers, kitchen, mirrors, office, rugs, storage, throws, vases), /products/lighting/ (floor-lamp, pendant-lamps, table-lamps, wall-lamps), /products/outdoor/ (accessories, seating, tables), /products/seating/ (bar--counter, benches, dining-chairs, lounge, office, outdoor, sofa), /products/shop-by-family/ (19 named furniture families/collections e.g. Fiber, Oslo, Linear, Compile), /products/sofas/ (2/3/4-seater, back-to-back, chaise-longue, corner, daybeds, highback, lounge-chairs, modular-sofas, poufs--ottomans, sofa-cushions, studio), /products/storage/ (bookcases, hallway-storage, modular-storage-systems, office-storage, sideboards, small-storage), /products/tables/ (cafe, coffee-side-tables, dining, high, office, outdoor, table-systems). Every category name is by function/room/product-type only; none named after a holiday, festival, or season, in English or Danish (checked visible nav text as rendered, not just URL slugs). Also checked /stories/ (editorial/blog hub) for gift-guide or holiday-themed editorial content that might link out to a real PLP -> none found (grepped for christmas|holiday|halloween|easter|valentine|gift-guide, zero matches). Accessories include candleholders and other items that could incidentally be used at Christmas, but no candleholders/accessories sub-line is itself framed by the site as seasonal (no 'Christmas', 'Advent', 'Holiday Edit' etc. category) -> correctly excluded per the 'contains seasonal products is not a seasonal category' rule. Did not use internal site search (disallowed by robots.txt for all bots at /search, and a zero-result search would not be proof of absence regardless) -- conclusion rests on the full nav/category tree and sitemap review, not on search. Muuto is a high-end Scandinavian design furniture/lighting brand with a permanent, function-based catalog and no seasonal/gifting merchandising layer on this site. No Claude-in-Chrome needed; tier 1 access gave a complete, reliable picture.
